text:
noah: Uploaded a mock for a "Share" flow in the Trace Viewer — idea: add a "Copy permalink" button next to the trace title and a small Export dropdown (Export .zip, Export JSON, Send to Sentry). Link: https://redwood.design/mockups/1923456789.png
priya: Generally +1. A couple things: what does permalink encode? full trace vs request-scoped? we should offer two permalinks: "Trace permalink (full)" and "Request permalink (current span)" so integrators can link precisely. Also include a TTL or version in the URL if we support rolling deletes.
leo: Implementation notes: permalinks should be short (use id tokens) and support optional ?span=span_id. Example: `/t/abcd1234?span=ef12`. For Export to Sentry we need to map our span -> Sentry event fields; could be async. CSV export for error lists is expensive; prefer JSON/zip.
aria: Accessibility & copy guidance: label the button aria-label="Copy trace permalink" not just "Copy link". When copying, announce via aria-live: "Trace permalink copied". For the visible permalink display use visually-truncated text with visually-hidden full URL so screen readers get the full path. Ensure contrast for the link text at small sizes.
noah: UX Q: when showing permalink preview should we reveal full id on hover or show a truncated pill with a "Show full" affordance? leaning truncated by default to avoid overwhelming the header.
priya: Truncated by default is fine. Add a small chevron to expand and a copy button inside expanded view that includes an explicit checkbox "Include span id" so users can choose trace vs trace:span.
leo: Dev detail: for clipboard we can do `navigator.clipboard.writeText(permalink)` with fallback. For async exports return a job id and surface a toast with progress + link to Downloads panel. Also add server-side rate-limit for exports.
infra-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood.design/previews/1923456789 — feedback open for 48h :calendar:
